silhercorp.title: Silher Corp
responsibilities: Fullstack development of multi-product corporate platform (HREPS, SIGNIA, KURA) under GAMP5 Category 4 regulatory standard
Building backend microservices with Java 21 + Spring Boot 4, strict hexagonal architecture, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ and Valkey/Redis caching
Developing Angular 21 microfrontends with Module Federation, PrimeNG and Tailwind CSS in Nx monorepo
Implementing multi-stage CI/CD pipelines in GitLab: validation, tests (JUnit, TestContainers, ArchUnit), SonarQube, Docker build, Helm deploy to OKE
Infrastructure as Code with Terraform on OCI (OKE, OCIR, VCN, Object Storage, KMS)
100% test coverage with JaCoCo (backend) and Jest/Playwright (frontend)
